t: Robust Forge Steel carpenters awl designed for precision marking and creating pilot holes in timber and other wood-based materials. Features a 75mm long, pointed round blade constructed from chrome vanadium steel, ensuring durability and accurate penetration for various carpentry tasks, such as marking out joinery or preparing screw holes. A tip diameter of 0.1mm allows for fine, detailed work. The ergonomic bi-material soft-grip handle provides comfortable handling and enhanced control during prolonged use, making it ideal for professional carpenters and dedicated DIY enthusiasts needing reliable performance in workshops and on site.
b: Pointed Round Chrome Vanadium Steel Blade
